items.name: Simple Chicken Tacos
ingredients: Half a red onion, thinly sliced
1 cup thinly-sliced or shaved red cabbage
1 teaspoon kosher salt (Diamond brand; use less of others)
½ teaspoon smoked or regular paprika
steps: First, prep your fixings: (Or be stuck eating cold chicken by the time they’re ready.)
For the tortillas: Wrap tortillas in foil, or place in a tortilla warmer or similar dish, and place in a 350-degree oven.
For the onions: Combine red onion, red wine vinegar, 1 tablespoon of water, ½ teaspoon kosher salt, and ¼ teaspoon granulated sugar and set aside to begin to pickle.

However, my new favorite trick is to place this bowl in the microwave for 10 to 15 seconds (just until the liquid gets hot), and then leave it aside to cool while you make everything else. The onions become pink and pickled much faster.

For the cabbage: I’m not going to bore us with cabbage-slicing directions. I just wanted to mention that I bought this peeler a couple years ago and I love it for rendering cabbage into a fluffy pile of lettuce, with ease.

Now, make your chicken: Combine the salt, cumin, chili powder, paprika, and pepper in a small bowl. Spread chicken thighs out on a tray and sprinkle each side of the cutlets lightly with the seasoning.

Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat until very hot, then add 2 to 3 tablespoons of olive oil. Once the oil is hot, arrange chicken in one layer and cook until browned underneath, about 4 to 5 minutes. Flip chicken, and cook until browned on the second side. Don’t worry if it’s not cooked through. Transfer chicken briefly to a plate.
In the empty skillet, add garlic and cook for a minute, until it turns golden. Add broth and use it to scrape any stuck bits off the pan. It will quickly come to a simmer.

Return the chicken and any juices that have collected to the pan, reduce the heat to medium, and cook chicken in the broth for 3 to 4 minutes, until the broth has reduced to a thin puddle. Turn heat off.
You can either shred the chicken in the pan with two forks or use the edge of your spatula to cut it into bite-sized pieces, stirring it around in any liquid left.
Assemble your tacos: Pile each warm tortilla with shredded chicken, any juices left in the pan, and all of the toppings. Inhale. Repeat again every week.

items.name: Apple Crisp
ingredients: 6 cups diced apples (I use 4-5 large Honeycrisp, unpeeled)
½ cup salted butter, melted (1 stick)
steps: Preheat Oven: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Mix Apple Filling: Toss diced apples with the sugar, cinnamon, and flour in a large bowl until well-coated. Transfer to a 9×9 baking dish or a cast-iron skillet.

Mix Topping: Mix melted butter, brown sugar, flour, oats, vanilla, and salt in a large bowl. Stir together with a spoon or fork. If needed, use your hands to bring the mixture together into a crumble; distribute evenly over the apples in the pan.
Bake: Bake for 40-45 minutes, until the apples are jammy-looking around the edges, and the topping is golden brown.
Rest and Serve: Let stand for 10-15 minutes, so the apple layer can cool and thicken slightly. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

items.name: Taco Pie
ingredients: 3 10-inch flour tortillas burrito size (I used low carb)
1 small yellow onion cut into ¼-inch dice
1 green bell pepper cut into ¼-inch dice
1 red bell pepper cut into ¼-inch dice
⅓ cup plain nonfat Greek yogurt at room temperature, plus additional for serving
2 teaspoons hot sauce I used Cholula
1 ½ cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese or pepper Jack cheese 6 ounces, divided
Sour cream or plain Greek yogurt
Sliced green onion or chopped cilantro
steps: Place a rack in the center of your oven and preheat to 375°F. Lightly coat a 9-inch deep dish pie plate with nonstick spray. If the tortillas feel stiff, warm them in the microwave for 15 seconds so they bend easily without cracking.

Lay the tortillas into the pie plate, overlapping them across the center so that the edges of the tortillas slightly extend over the top of the plate like the sides of a pie crust. Pleat the edges to flatten them along the edge of the plate. Mist all over with nonstick spray and bake 5 minutes. Set aside.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Add the onion, red bell pepper, and green bell pepper. Cook, stirring, until softened, 8 to 10 minutes.

Add the beef and cook, breaking it into small crumbles. Add the chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, garlic powder, oregano, salt, black pepper, cayenne, and green chiles. Stir and continue to break apart the meat until it is fully cooked through and no pink remains.
Transfer the beef mixture to a large bowl and let it cool 10 minutes, stirring once or twice to release heat from the bottom of the bowl.

In a medium bowl, whisk the eggs, Greek yogurt, and hot sauce together until completely smooth with no white streaks. Pour over the cooled beef, add 1 cup of the shredded cheese, and fold until everything is evenly combined.

Spread the filling into the tortilla crust, smoothing the top into an even layer. Sprinkle with the remaining ½ cup cheese. With foil strips or a pie crust shield, tend the edges of the tortilla so it doesn't overbrown.
Bake 40 to 45 minutes, until the center is set (use a butter knife to peek into the center. It should look moist but you shouldn't see liquid pooling).

Let the taco pie rest 10 minutes. Use a long knife with a sharp, pointy tip to slice (it takes a bit of elbow grease to get through the tortillas). Or for easier slicing, use a large spatula to gently and carefully slide the pie out onto a cutting board, then slice with a chef's knife. Serve with a generous amount of your toppings of choice

items.name: Ground Chicken Stir Fry
ingredients: 2 tablespoons canola oil or similar neutral cooking oil, divided
8 ounces cremini mushrooms super finely chopped
2 tablespoons low-sodium soy sauce plus more to taste, divided
¼ teaspoon red-pepper flakes plus more to taste
1 (2-inch) piece of fresh ginger peeled and finely chopped
4 green onions thinly sliced, white and light green parts separated from the dark green parts
2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lime juice from about 1 juicy lime
½ cup chopped or torn fresh mint or basil
For serving: white rice or brown rice
steps: Heat a large, deep saucepan (or a wok) over medium-high heat. Once it’s hot, add the oil. Then, add the chicken, using the back of a spoon to press it into a single layer. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Let it cook without disturbing it for 3 minutes. You want it to sear.

Break up the meat into small pieces, stirring so it browns. Add the mushrooms, 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of the fish sauce, and the red pepper flakes. Cook until the mushrooms completely soften and almost disappear into the meat, about 5 minutes. Transfer to a large plate or bowl.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the remaining tablespoon oil. Add the celery and cook 1 minute. Then stir in the broccoli slaw and cook until crisp-tender, about 3 minutes more.
Add the garlic, ginger, and white and light green parts of the green onions. Cook for 1 minute more.
Return the chicken mixture to the skillet. Stir in the lime juice and remaining 1 tablespoon fish sauce and 1 tablespoon soy sauce.
Stir in the cilantro, mint or basil, and reserved green onion tops. Enjoy hot with prepared rice.

items.name: Cheeseburger Sliders
ingredients: ¾ lb lean ground beef or ground turkey
¼ cup finely diced yellow onion
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
1 (12-count) package KING’S HAWAIIAN Original Hawaiian Sweet Dinner Rolls halved lengthwise
6 ounces shredded sharp cheddar cheese about 1 ½ cups, divided
½ cup chopped dill pickle chips
steps: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.

Heat vegetable oil in a large cast iron skillet over medium heat. Add ground beef and cook until beef has browned, about 3-5 minutes, making sure to crumble the beef as it cooks. Add onion and Worcestershire sauce. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 2-3 minutes; season with salt and pepper, to taste.
Lightly oil a baking dish or coat with nonstick spray. Place bottom half of dinner rolls onto the prepared baking dish and sprinkle with half the cheese, about ¾ cup.
Top with ground beef in an even layer, pressing lightly. Sprinkle with pickles and remaining cheese.
Place top half of dinner rolls, cut-side down, on top. Brush tops of dinner rolls with egg white; sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Place into oven and bake until golden brown and the cheese has melted, about 12-14 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes.
Serve warm with burger sauce.

items.name: 36 Healthy Fall Dinners With All The Cozy
Chicken with Cajun Sauce
ingredients: 1 ½ teaspoon Cajun seasoning (I used McCormick)
1 cup chicken broth (I use water + 1 tsp Better Than Bouillon)
steps: Prep the Chicken: Cut the chicken into thinner pieces horizontally, or pound them out a bit so they’re thinner.

Cook the Chicken: Season the chicken filets with Cajun seasoning. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat (I use a nonstick for this). Sauté the chicken on each side for 3-4 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 165 and the outside is golden; remove from the pan and set aside on a plate.
Sauté Shallots: Wipe off any overly browned bits from the pan. Turn the heat to medium-low so the butter and shallots don’t burn. Add butter and shallots; saute until softened and fragrant.
Make The Roux: Add tomato paste and Cajun seasoning; saute for 3-4 minutes until the tomato paste has developed a rich color. Add flour and mix; cook for 2-3 minutes to remove any floury taste.

Finish Sauce: Add broth gradually; whisk to incorporate after each addition. Once it’s smooth, add heavy cream and whisk again to incorporate. Let it simmer for 5-10 minutes to thicken slightly. Add chicken back to the pan so it is partially submerged with sauce.
Serve: Serve pieces of chicken with a spoonful of the sauce over the top. I love this SO MUCH with mashed potatoes and broccoli – see notes!

items.name: Upside Down Apple Tart
ingredients: 6 tablespoons unsalted butter sliced into 6 even pieces
½ to 1 teaspoon flakey sea salt or kosher salt
2 medium Honeycrisp Granny Smith, or similar crisp apples, sliced ⅛ inch thick
1 sheet frozen puff pastry thawed according to package directions
1 large egg beaten with 1 teaspoon water to create an egg wash
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper (make sure it’s rimmed, the juices will flow!).

Drizzle the honey onto the parchment in 6 evenly spaced “squiggles” creating 2 rows of 3. For each, draw a straight line with the honey that is about 2 inches long, then swirl the honey back and forth over the line in an “S” shape (see video). Set a pat of butter in the center of each. Your goal is to create a “grid” to lay the pastry on.
Sprinkle each pat of butter with a pinch each of brown sugar, cinnamon, and salt (exact measurements aren’t necessary; just eyeball it).

Fan the apple slices over the pats of butter to create 3 long columns placed side by side. Start with the right or left side, running the apples evenly over the 3 pats of butter. Tuck the apples snugly against each other so no parchment peeks through (they will go up and over the pats of butter). Arrange the apples so they are fanning either directly towards or directly away from you.

Once you’ve finished the first column, complete the middle column, nestling the apples between the 2 columns of butter so they are directly on the parchment. For this column, lay the apples in short rows with the fans pointing left, then right (it will be slightly narrower than the other 2 columns)
Then, do the final column, arranging it over the remaining pats. You’re aiming for a rectangle roughly 8×10 inches.

Unfold the puff pastry on a lightly floured work surface. Roll it into a rectangle that’s about 2 inches longer than the apples on each side (mine was 10×13). Drape the pastry over the apples like a blanket. With the tines of a fork, press all the way around the edges of the pastry to create a border.
Brush the pastry lightly and evenly with the egg wash. Dab up any pools with a paper towel.
Bake for 30 minutes on the center rack, until the pastry is deeply golden and puffed.

Let rest for 5 to 10 minutes (some juices will have escaped and browned; simply scoop them away with a spoon and discard). Set a large cutting board over the pan and with one big, confident motion, flip it over. Lift away the pan and peel off the parchment. Dust with powdered sugar as desired and slice into squares.

items.name: Tomato Risotto with Frizzled Red Onions
ingredients: 2 pounds (905 grams) large, ripe beefsteak tomatoes, halved
1 medium-large red onion, halved and thinly sliced
⅓ cup (80 ml) dry white wine
1 cup (200 grams) uncooked arborio or carnaroli, or another short-grained rice, such as sushi rice
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
2 to 3 tablespoons (30 to 45 grams) butter or olive oil, to finish
steps: Heat oven: To 350°F.

Prepare the risotto: Grate halved tomatoes, the cut side pressing against the large holes of a box grater, pressing the tomato flesh and juices through and reserving as much as you can of the outer skin. Discard it. You should have about 2 ½ to 3 cups of tomato pulp.

In a 4-quart Dutch oven [I’m using this ] or deep, oven-safe saucepan with a lid, heat 3 to 4 tablespoons olive oil on medium-high heat. Add red onion and cook, stirring, until it softens, then continue to cook until the pieces become deeply golden brown and mostly crisp, about 8 to 10 minutes. Transfer half to a paper towel-lined plate and season with salt. Set it aside.

Add garlic to onions left in the pan and cook, stirring, for one minute. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper, plus a pinch or two of red pepper flakes. Add uncooked rice and toast gently in the onion and garlic for 3 minutes. Add wine and cook, stirring, until it disappears.

Pour in your grated tomato pulp, then 2 cups of water. Season it well — I add 2 teaspoons kosher salt to start, then more to taste, plus many grinds of black pepper. Bring mixture to a simmer, then turn heat off.

Place lid on pot and transfer to the oven. Bake risotto for 25 to 30 minutes, or until most of the liquid is absorbed, but it looks a tiny bit watery. I like to check in halfway just to make sure all of the liquid isn’t absorbed. If it looks low, add another ½ cup water.

To finish: Transfer pan to a trivet or cooling rack on your counter. Remove the lid and stir mixture for 2 minutes, or until it looks more creamy and risotto-like. Taste and adjust seasonings, adding more salt and pepper to your taste.
Add 2 to 3 tablespoons of butter (or olive oil) to finish, stirring it in. Scatter with toppings of your choice, such as parmesan and torn basil. Finish with reserved frizzled onions and serve.

items.name: Gyro Recipe
ingredients: 1 pound lean ground beef I used 90% lean
1 pound ground lamb or 85/15 ground beef
Pita bread brown rice, white rice, or Lemon Rice
Tzatziki sauce, plain Greek yogurt, or cottage cheese
Hummus a fun bonus on the side
steps: Place a rack in the upper third of the oven and preheat to 400°F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper (I used an 11×17-inch sheet pan).

In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, ground lamb, garlic, oregano, cumin, cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Turn it out onto the prepared baking sheet. With your fingers, squish it into a thin, even layer that extends nearly to the edges of the paper.

With a bench scraper or butter knife, score the meat lengthwise (hot dog style) down the center, then crosswise into 1-inch strips. Lightly brush the top with oil (I drizzled a bit on, then used a pastry brush to spread it).

Place in the oven on the upper-third rack and bake for 15 to 20 minutes, until the meat is cooked through and beginning to brown on top. It will release a good amount of liquid and some grease, but don’t be alarmed—it’s going to taste great.
Remove the pan from the oven and carefully pour off the excess liquid. With a bench scraper or knife, separate the meat back into strips (it will have fused along the score lines as the meat cooked).
Warm the pita in the microwave, or place it on a lower oven rack for a minute or two. Load up your gyro with tzatziki, strips of the cooked gyro meat, and your toppings of choice. Enjoy warm.

items.name: Air Fryer Chicken
ingredients: Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
steps: In a small bowl, combine brown sugar, paprika, thyme, 1 teaspoon salt and ½ teaspoon pepper. Pat the chicken dry with paper towels; season with the spice rub and sprinkle with cornstarch in an even layer, shaking off any excess.
Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees F. Place chicken in a single layer in the air fryer basket, working in batches, if needed. Spray with avocado oil spray.
Air fry, flipping halfway, until cooked through and golden brown, reaching an internal temperature of 165 degrees F, about 14 minutes.
Serve immediately.
